clue.text: Story about quiet bird in watery home

indicators.note: the story wraps around the quiet sign, placed about it

parts.note: a fib is a small lie, a made-up story
SH is the call for quiet
an owl is a bird

explanation.surface: A story about a quiet bird that lives in a watery home, like a children's tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A goldfish's glass tank is, jokingly, its watery home.

clue.text: Type of dough I cut in firm lines

indicators.note: I and cut go inside the word for firm

parts.note: fast means firm, fixed
to lop is to cut
RY is short for railway, and lines are railway lines

explanation.surface: A baker describes a dough by slicing it into firm strips.
explanation.definitionFit: Filo is a paper-thin pastry dough used in Greek and Middle Eastern baking.

clue.text: Mammal abandoning lake for bigger expanse of water

indicators.note: the mammal leaves the lake's letter behind

parts.note: a seal is a ... mammal
L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: A seal leaves a lake for the open ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea is a larger body of water than a lake.

clue.text: Shut in, as is revolutionary, say, imprisoned by queen?

indicators.note: the following letters are held inside the queen

parts.note: the queen of a hive is a bee, hence the question mark

indicators.note: something revolutionary turns round, so the word is is read backwards

parts.note: EG (for example) is what say means

explanation.surface: A revolutionary, perhaps, locked up by the queen.
explanation.definitionFit: To besiege is to surround and hem in, keeping people shut in.

clue.text: Man wishes possibly to seize crown? I can't remember who

indicators.note: the jumbled letters grab the crown inside them
the letters may possibly be arranged otherwise

parts.note: a crown is a hat, informally

explanation.surface: A man who wishes to seize the crown, and the speaker cannot recall his name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges MAN WISHES, which takes in HAT.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is what you say when you have forgotten someone's name.

clue.text: Slow progress by son — handwriting not very good

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
to crawl is to make slow progress

explanation.surface: A slow-progressing son whose handwriting is poor, as in a school report.
explanation.definitionFit: Untidy, hurried writing that is hard to read is called a scrawl.

clue.text: Horseman in a very old city going after money

indicators.note: the a and the city follow the money

parts.note: a cent is a small coin, money
Ur is the ancient Sumerian city

explanation.surface: A rider in an ancient city chasing money.
explanation.definitionFit: A centaur of Greek myth is half man, half horse: a horse-man literally.

clue.text: Devious inmate with hemp has smuggled in a different drug

indicators.note: the jumbled letters hold the a inside them
devious means twisting, roundabout, so the letters wander out of order

explanation.surface: A crafty prisoner, with cannabis, has also sneaked in another narcotic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Devious' rearranges INMATE HEMP, which takes in A. 'different' says this drug is other than the hemp.
explanation.definitionFit: Amphetamine is a stimulant drug, unlike cannabis.

clue.text: Fat landlord must lose a bit in the middle

indicators.text: must lose a bit in the middle
indicators.note: the word landlord has a central chunk taken out

explanation.surface: An overweight pub landlord needs to slim his waist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must lose a bit in the middle' removes NDLO from LANDLORD.
explanation.definitionFit: Lard is pig fat used in cooking.

clue.text: Guide sailor needs a lot to begin with

indicators.note: says the word for a lot comes first, before the sailor

parts.note: loads means a lot
a tar is an old word for a sailor

explanation.surface: A sailor needs plenty of guidance when starting out.
explanation.definitionFit: A lodestar, the pole star, is used to steer by, so figuratively anything that guides.

clue.text: One shooting bird by river

parts.note: a snipe is a wading bird
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A hunter shooting a bird beside a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The word for this marksman came from those skilled enough to shoot the elusive snipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A marksman firing from cover is one who is shooting.

clue.text: Serious Aussies who may work alongside the church

definitions.text: who may work alongside the church

parts.note: grave means serious
digger is slang for an Australian, especially a soldier

explanation.surface: Solemn Australians labouring next to a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who dig burial plots work in the churchyard beside the church.

clue.text: Old female in crowd gets to speak, one interrupting chair

indicators.note: old and female are placed in the crowd

parts.note: a press is a crowd or throng

indicators.note: the numeral one breaks into the word for speak

parts.note: to orate is to speak formally
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An old woman in a crowd gets her turn to speak, and someone cuts across the chairman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chair' is not a meeting's chairman but a university professorship, standing for the professors collectively.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of professors at a university are those holding chairs, collectively the professoriate.

clue.text: How you will be judged in exam — prepare to get going

definitions.text: How you will be judged in exam
definitions.meaning: an exam is assessed by the points you earn
the call to runners to take their places before a race starts

explanation.definitionFit: The starter's call before 'get set, go' tells runners to be ready; literally, exam judgement depends on scores.

clue.text: Award amount of money, as one might say, for interfering?

indicators.note: says the words are taken by their sound when spoken

parts.note: an award is a medal and an amount of money is a sum

explanation.surface: A prize of cash, as someone would put it, for poking one's nose in.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who meddles keeps interfering in others' affairs.

clue.text: Design steps for the auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where things are heard, so the word is taken as it sounds

parts.note: a stile is a set of steps for climbing over a fence

explanation.surface: Designing a set of steps for a concert hall.
explanation.definitionFit: A design or fashion is a style, as in a style of dress.

clue.text: Veteran is treated, getting intestinal enzyme

indicators.note: the letters are processed or worked on, like a substance being treated

explanation.surface: An old soldier receiving treatment involving a gut enzyme.
explanation.definitionFit: Invertase, or sucrase, is an enzyme in the intestine that splits sucrose.

clue.text: Female in make-up, daughter became more crude

indicators.note: the female goes inside the make-up

parts.note: rouge is red make-up for the cheeks
a hen is a female bird

explanation.surface: A woman wearing make-up, and her daughter turned coarser.
explanation.definitionFit: To roughen is to make or become rougher, i.e. cruder or less refined.

clue.text: The female's entertaining university folk reluctant to socialise

indicators.note: the word for hers takes the university in, like a host

parts.note: hers means belonging to the female
MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology

explanation.surface: She hosts university people who prefer to keep to themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Recluses who live apart from society are unwilling to mix with others.

clue.text: After capture, Charles I was restricted, king being held

indicators.note: the king's letter is held within the word for restricted

parts.note: tied means restricted or bound
R is the abbreviation for king (Rex)

explanation.surface: History: after his capture, Charles I was confined while the king was held.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a whole phrase: after his capture in the Civil War, Charles I was put on trial in 1649.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles I stood trial before Parliament's court after he was captured, and was executed.

clue.text: Vehicle in on-screen advertisement

definitions.meaning: a wagon pulled behind a car or lorry
a preview of a coming film shown in cinemas

explanation.surface: A car appearing in a TV advert.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a towed vehicle and a film preview.

clue.text: Legendary mama represented as female saint

indicators.note: the letters are presented again in a new form

explanation.surface: A legendary mother figure is portrayed as a woman saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Mary of Magdala, a follower of Jesus, is venerated as a saint.

clue.text: Measure heading off old poet

indicators.note: the poet's name loses its first letter, its head

parts.note: Homer is the ancient Greek epic poet

explanation.surface: An ancient poet's measured lines trimmed at the top.
explanation.definitionFit: An omer is an ancient Hebrew dry measure, a tenth of an ephah.

clue.text: Saint has home by marketplace

parts.note: a mart is a marketplace
in means at home

explanation.surface: A saint living next to the market.
explanation.definitionFit: St Martin of Tours is a well-known saint.

clue.text: Affluent dresser in Derbyshire will have this before celebration

parts.words: dresser in Derbyshire will have this
parts.note: well dressing is a Derbyshire custom of decorating wells with flower pictures, so a dresser there works on a well
a to-do is a fuss or party

explanation.surface: A wealthy Derbyshire person with a dresser at home before a party.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'dresser' is not furniture: well dressing is a Derbyshire village custom of decorating wells with flower-petal pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-to-do describes people who are prosperous, comfortably off.

clue.text: An ending for many Russian women in cells

definitions.text: An ending for many Russian women
definitions.meaning: feminine Russian surnames often end this way, as in Ivanova

explanation.surface: Many Russian women's prison terms finishing in cells.
explanation.definitionFit: Ova are female reproductive cells, and the suffix marks feminine surnames like Petrova.

clue.text: Support outside is making stand firm

indicators.note: the support sits outside the word is

parts.note: a rest is a support, as for a cue

explanation.surface: Support from outside is what lets someone stay firm under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To withstand or oppose something is to stand firm against it.

clue.text: American eagle that's caught in the morning gets form of identification

indicators.note: the eagle catches the morning inside it

parts.note: an erne is a sea eagle
AM means in the morning

explanation.surface: An American eagle trapped one morning is given an ID tag.
explanation.definitionFit: Your login name on a computer system identifies you.
